kind: Existing V8 code and permanent bug-board regression audit
scope: cohort availability and GPU admission context
checkout updates during an active worker
branch bank/budget endpoints/checkpoint and reward export

confirmed_defects.problem: Full console can block supervisor stop logging and standalone stop before cleanup, then Python final flush.
confirmed_defects.fix: Control diagnostics are best effort in daemon writers; exit is bounded after cleanup. Child output goes to private local console log and is relayed separately.
confirmed_defects.evidence: before.xml first2failures; blocked receiver still allows simulated2MiB work milestone and bounded SIGINT cleanup after fix.

confirmed_defects.problem: Legacy untagged coordinator can spawn a detached rank after initial stop snapshot; stop falsely returns success.
confirmed_defects.fix: Refresh the selected same-node/UID/root scope throughout termination; retain PID creation-time checks.
confirmed_defects.evidence: before.xml thirdfailure; newly spawned TERM-ignoring rank removed after fix.

confirmed_defects.problem: One cohort source/metadata/missing interpreter can abort preflight before the healthy other cohort starts.
confirmed_defects.fix: Collect per-cohort selection errors, continue only valid cohorts, preserve failure exit1 after valid work. Explicit missing cohort interpreter is never silently replaced.
confirmed_defects.evidence: before.xml/environment-before.xml; unknown source/malformed identity/partial JSON/missing interpreter and aggregate-exit checks.

confirmed_defects.problem: Different cohort interpreters were grouped under one coordinator; frozen admission uses sys.executable, possibly the other cohort environment.
confirmed_defects.fix: Separate workers by exact selected Python path as well as source. Each admission and child starts in its own recorded environment.
confirmed_defects.evidence: before.xml lastfailure; actual launch argument/environment interception verifies both selected Python contexts.

confirmed_defects.problem: Live current source paths could change after selection and before a later child launch during git pull.
confirmed_defects.fix: Freeze selected production coordinator/runner/helper/CSV bytes before exec. Verify hashes and retain a private source registry for later pulls/restarts.
confirmed_defects.evidence: hot-pull-before.xml; simulate checkout worker+child replacement, verify selected bytes unchanged and queue reopens from the original local snapshot without the old checkout.

confirmed_defects.problem: Status used local GPU idle state for remote jobs and truncated FQDN at the first dot.
confirmed_defects.fix: Merge current status layout, preserve full host and scope GPU warning to the same host.
confirmed_defects.evidence: status-before.xml; remote hostname/GPU ownership controls and local positive control.

confirmed_defects.problem: Old worker detecting a changed binding called pool.fail and poisoned the new queue state.
confirmed_defects.fix: Handle BindingMismatch separately and stop the old cohort without writing its failure into the new queue.
confirmed_defects.evidence: poison-before.xml; simulated source replacement verifies the new binding and its failure=None stay unchanged.

confirmed_defects.problem: Incoming status change inferred stopped learner and safe resume from stale/missing heartbeat, even with fresh remote work logs.
confirmed_defects.fix: Mark activity unconfirmed and liveness unverified, never claim ranks/leases stopped or promise automatic resume from heartbeat age.
confirmed_defects.evidence: heartbeat-before.xml; fresh work log +900s stale heartbeat cannot become stopped or next-worker-resumes advice.

failure_retention: Original failed reproductions retained. after.xml also retains3development fixture failures: two whole-stdout JSON assumptions after explicit console log relay, one stale status fixture assumed a remote hostname was local. Updated fixtures preserve the intended controls; no failure deleted.

scientific_results.intermediate_records: Actual CPU runner interruption/resume, checkpoint hashes and distinct training/held-out exports verified. Unmeasured held-out intermediate points stay unmeasured; no real model reward inferred.

preservation: No original frozen trainer/adapter/numerical child modifications. Existing queue bindings, checkpoints, optimizer/RNG and reward records are not rewritten by source selection. Historical runtimes remain exact bytes; current coordinator ownership fix does not silently relabel an existing historical queue.
limitations: Different source/Python groups run sequentially on one GPU group; identical source/environment keeps original automatic two-cohort dispatch.
Linux uninterruptible kernel I/O can outlive SIGKILL; remaining PIDs must not be reported as released.
Actual H100 progress, GPU throughput and cross-node filesystem lock behavior were not measured.
publication: git pull in existing checkout; same sh scripts/run_v8_nodes.sh. No archive extraction required.
